highlights: Lightweight runtime — The runtime handles model acquisition, hardware acceleration, model management, and inference (via ONNX Runtime).
Smart model management — Foundry Local handles the full lifecycle of models on end-user devices.
Optional local server — An OpenAI-compatible web server for serving models to multiple processes, integrating with tools like LangChain, or experimenting through REST calls.
A single FoundryLocalManager can manage both chat and audio models simultaneously.
